scope.selection_reason: Full sessions preserve long-horizon dependencies. Survey covers denominator/scope changes and observed syntax/sampling overhead; BI covers weights, bins and rollback; Water covers fitted models, feature/population changes and repair loops. Selection is fixed before new model runs. These are development tasks previously audited, not an unseen holdout or the complete benchmark.
scope.judge_protocol: Unchanged upstream prompt and frozen LongDS v1 references; score 1 is a pass. Judge new outputs only; retain previous results.
scope.trial_policy: Report first pass separately; two additional full-session repetitions quantify variability and recovery without replacing first-pass scores.
scope.model_cost_target: At most 1.25 times matched persistent DSGym cost while retaining the accuracy gain; also compare to the strongest saved react-entries arm.
scope.comparability_limit: Historical controls ran frozen R3; this revision includes previously unmeasured correctness fixes already present locally plus the new efficiency changes. No isolated causal attribution to one new change. Shared backend/model gateway remains the same; resource scheduling is bounded separately.

session_budget.policy_note: Predeclared one-hour session cap; same cap as historical controls; all missing questions count as failures.

limitations: Historical controls, not a simultaneous randomized A/B test.
Previously audited development tasks; does not establish full-benchmark generalization.
A combined revision; no ablation isolates each fix, and existing post-control correctness fixes are also present.
Repository cache-aware model-cost estimates, not provider invoices or infrastructure charges.
Provider requests failing or stopping without returned usage cannot be priced from these traces; unmetered_error_turns lists detected completed-turn cases.
First pass and repetitions are separate; old outputs and scores are unchanged.

acceptance_check.limits: Historical comparisons on three development tasks; budget stops and unreported provider usage remain explicit.
